A '''Military Database Computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] installed in [[M-3PO military protocol droid]]s. The computer held the rules, regulations, and procedures of over six million military and paramilitary organizations. This included honor codes, ceremonial protocols and doctrines for military forces past and present.<ref name="EGTD" />
